export interface ContractDescriptor {
    readonly contractId: string;
    readonly kind: "module" | "service" | "platform";
    readonly schemaVersion: number;
    readonly maturity: PackageMaturity;
    readonly ssot: string;
}

export interface PackageDescriptor {
    readonly packageName: string;
    readonly packagePath: string;
    readonly kind: PackageKind;
    readonly maturity: PackageMaturity;
    readonly contract: string;
    readonly migrationGoals: readonly string[];
    readonly ssot: string;
    readonly capabilities: readonly string[];
}

export type PackageKind = "app" | "foundation" | "module" | "horizontal" | "native-plugin" | "integration-plugin" | "tooling";

export type PackageMaturity = "contract-only" | "partial" | "implemented";

export declare const packageDescriptor: {
    readonly packageName: "@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts";
    readonly packagePath: "packages/contracts";
    readonly kind: "foundation";
    readonly maturity: "contract-only";
    readonly contract: "@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/package";
    readonly migrationGoals: readonly ["goal-reorg-f2", "goal-reorg-f3"];
    readonly ssot: "docs/SSOT-MATRIX.md";
    readonly capabilities: readonly [];
};
